'''Tie:''' {{legend0|#d2b1d9|40–50%}} {{legend0|#ae8bb1|50%}} {{legend0|#808080|No votes}} }} {{Elections in Nevada sidebar}} The '''2022 United States Senate election in Nevada''' was held on November 8, 2022, to elect a member of the [[United States Senate]] to represent the [[Nevada|State of Nevada]]. Incumbent [[Nevada Democratic Party|Democratic]] senator [[Catherine Cortez Masto]] won re-election to a second term, narrowly defeating [[Nevada Republican Party|Republican]] former state attorney general [[Adam Laxalt]].{{cite news |url=https://www.reuters.com/world/us/democrats-await-nevada-election-result-that-could-seal-their-us-senate-majority-2022-11-12/ |title=Democrats seal control of U.S. Senate with win in Nevada |newspaper=Reuters |date=November 13, 2022 |last1=Reid |first1=Tim |last2=Lange |first2=Jason }} Nevada's election results were slowed due to state law that allowed voters to submit mail-in ballots until November 12, and allowed voters to fix clerical problems in their mail-in ballots until November 14, 2022.{{cite news |last1=Catalini |first1=Mike |title=Why Nevada election results are taking days |url=https://apnews.com/article/2022-midterm-elections-nevada-ballot-counting-896bf9df5d24efbdfeef92f1c10799f0 |access-date=November 13, 2022 |work=[[Associated Press]] |date=November 12, 2022}} No Republican has won this specific U.S. Senate seat since Adam Laxalt's grandfather [[Paul Laxalt]] won a second full term in [[1980 United States Senate election in Nevada|1980]]. According to [[exit poll]]s, Cortez Masto won 83% of Black voters, 62% of Hispanic voters, 64% of [[Youth vote in the United States|young voters]], and 52% of women.{{Cite web |title=Exit polls for Midterm Election Results 2022 {{!}} CNN Politics |url=https://www.cnn.com/election/2022/exit-polls |access-date=November 13, 2022 |website=CNN |language=en}} Cortez Masto made protecting [[Abortion rights in the United States|abortion rights]] a central issue of her campaign.{{Cite web |title=Out-of-state donors, abortion ruling fueled Cortez Masto fundraising |url=https://thenevadaindependent.com/article/out-of-state-donors-abortion-ruling-fueled-cortez-masto-fundraising |access-date=November 13, 2022 |website=The Nevada Independent |date=August 4, 2022 |language=en}} Many experts and forecasters saw Nevada as Republicans' best chance to pickup a seat in the Senate. Despite Laxalt leading in most polls, Cortez Masto narrowly won re-election by a little less than 8,000 votes. Cortez Masto flipped [[Washoe County, Nevada|Washoe County]], improving her [[2016 United States Senate election in Nevada|2016 voteshare]] by 1.7%, although Laxalt improved on [[Joe Heck]]'s margin in rural counties, and performed slightly better in [[Clark County, Nevada|Clark County]]. The incumbent Democrat's improvements in [[Washoe County, Nevada|Washoe]] compared to [[2016 United States Senate election in Nevada|2016]] proved to be decisive, as her victory margin there was slightly larger than in Nevada as a whole. With a narrow margin of 0.78%, this was the closest Senate race of the 2022 election cycle and the closest Senate election in Nevada since [[1998 United States Senate election in Nevada|1998]]. ==
